info.title: Pulse API
info.description: HTTP API of the Pulse RSS reader, served under `/api` behind Nginx. All request and response bodies are JSON. Authentication uses the HttpOnly `pulse_session` cookie set by `POST /api/auth/login`. Requests other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS must carry an `Origin` (or `Referer`) header of the same host, otherwise they fail with 403 `auth.same_origin`. Request bodies are limited to 1 MiB, must be one JSON object, and must not contain unknown fields. Every response carries an `X-Request-ID` header, which also appears in the access log. Errors use the `Error` object; its `code` is stable and translated by the frontend. Each error response lists its codes in `x-error-codes`. `backend/test/internal/httpapi/openapi_test.go` fails when this file and the routes registered in `httpapi.New` differ.

get.summary: Export the user's subscriptions as OPML 2.0
get.description: Feeds without a folder come first, then one outline group per folder; feeds are sorted by personal title. Each feed outline has `text`/`title` (personal title), `type="rss"`, and `xmlUrl` (source URL).

200.description: OPML document, served as an attachment named `pulse-subscriptions.opml` with `Cache-Control: no-store`.

401.description: Not signed in or the session expired. Error codes: `auth.sign_in_required`, `auth.session_expired`.

500.description: Server or database error. Error codes: `opml.export_failed`, `auth.session_check_failed`.

post.summary: Import subscriptions from an OPML document
post.description: The raw OPML document is the request body (at most 1 MiB, 1,000 outlines, nesting depth 5). Outlines with `xmlUrl` are feeds; the nearest ancestor outline without `xmlUrl` names the folder (created if missing, matched case-insensitively). Feeds of already approved sources are subscribed directly; unknown URLs become approval requests, subject to the 10 pending requests and 100 subscriptions limits. Feeds the user already follows are skipped.

200.description: Import summary. `failed` lists at most 100 entries; `reason` is one of `feed.url_invalid`, `feed.url_too_long`, `feed.limit_reached`, `feed.request_limit_reached`.

400.description: The body is not a valid OPML subscription list (malformed XML, root other than `<opml>`, more than 1,000 outlines, or nesting deeper than 5). Error codes: `opml.invalid`.

sessionCookie.name: pulse_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque session token, valid for 14 days. Only its hash is stored.

X-Request-ID.description: Request ID: a well-formed incoming `X-Request-ID` (at most 64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]`, starting with a letter or digit) or a generated 32-character hex value.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `before` to load the next page.

code.description: Stable dotted error code; the frontend translates it (`apiErrors.<code>`).

requesters.description: Every requester's email address in request order.

FolderColor.description: A preset name or a six-digit hexadecimal color.

refreshIntervalMinutes.description: Personal refresh interval; `null` inherits the global one.
